name: treesitter
description: Synchronous Lua parser creation and deterministic scratch-buffer parse
setup: return function() local b=vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false,true); vim.api.nvim_set_current_buf(b); vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(b,0,-1,false,{'local function add(a, b)','  return a + b','end','return add(20, 22)'}) end

steps.name: lua-parse
steps.lua: return function(bench) local parser=bench.span('get_parser', vim.treesitter.get_parser, 0, 'lua'); local trees=bench.span('parse', function() return parser:parse(true) end); assert(#trees > 0 and trees[1]:root():type() == 'chunk', 'Lua syntax tree was not produced') end
